worked_solution:
Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-1}^{2}{x}^{3}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{{x}^{3+1}}{3+1}{|}_{-1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{{x}^{4}}{4}{|}_{-1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{{2}^{4}}{4}-\frac{(-1)^{4}}{4} \\  & =\frac{16}{4}-\frac{1}{4} \\  & =\frac{15}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
